physics-m3-q3.title: Massasi 2 kg bo'lgan
physics-m3-q3.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
physics-m3-q3.material: Massasi 2 kg bo'lgan rolikli poezd ishqalanishsiz yo'lning yerdan 20 m balandlikdagi nuqtasidan tinch holatdan yo'lga chiqdi. Yerga yetib kelgan paytdagi kinetik energiyasi qancha? (g = 9,8 m/s²)

physics-m3-q3.s.s1.explain: Mexanik energiyaning saqlanish qonuniga ko'ra kamaygan potensial energiya to'liq kinetik energiyaga aylanadi. $E_k = mgh = 2\text{ kg} \times 9.8\text{ m/s}^2 \times 20\text{ m} = 392\text{ J}$.

physics-m3-q3.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.

physics-m3-q4.title: Yo'lda avtomobil tezligi soatiga
physics-m3-q4.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
physics-m3-q4.material: Yo'lda avtomobil tezligi soatiga 50 km dan soatiga 100 km gacha 2 marta oshsa, keskin tormozlashda sirpanadigan tormozlanish masofasi nazariy jihatdan taxminan necha marta ortadi?

physics-killer-09.material: Termoyadro sintezi reaksiyasi $\mathrm{^2H}+\mathrm{^3H}\rightarrow\mathrm{^4He}+\mathrm{n}$ da har bir zarraning massasi $\mathrm{^2H}$: $2.0141\,\mathrm{u}$, $\mathrm{^3H}$: $3.0160\,\mathrm{u}$, $\mathrm{^4He}$: $4.0015\,\mathrm{u}$, neytron: $1.0086\,\mathrm{u}$. $1\,\mathrm{u}$ ga mos energiya $930\,\mathrm{MeV}$ deb olinadi va reaksiyadan oldingi zarralarning kinetik energiyasi e'tiborga olinmaydi. Bu reaksiyada ajraladigan energiya $E$ va hosil bo'lgan $\mathrm{^4He}$ va neytronning impuls kattaligi teng, massa nisbati $4:1$ deb yaqinlashtirilganda neytron ega bo'ladigan kinetik energiya tartib bilan to'g'ri juftlangan javob qaysi?
physics-killer-09.s.s1.prompt: Termoyadro sintezi reaksiyasi $\mathrm{^2H}+\mathrm{^3H}\rightarrow\mathrm{^4He}+\mathrm{n}$ da har bir zarraning massasi $\mathrm{^2H}$: $2.0141\,\mathrm{u}$, $\mathrm{^3H}$: $3.0160\,\mathrm{u}$, $\mathrm{^4He}$: $4.0015\,\mathrm{u}$, neytron: $1.0086\,\mathrm{u}$. $1\,\mathrm{u}$ ga mos energiya $930\,\mathrm{MeV}$ deb olinadi va reaksiyadan oldingi zarralarning kinetik energiyasi e'tiborga olinmaydi. Bu reaksiyada ajraladigan energiya $E$ va hosil bo'lgan $\mathrm{^4He}$ va neytronning impuls kattaligi teng, massa nisbati $4:1$ deb yaqinlashtirilganda neytron ega bo'ladigan kinetik energiya tartib bilan to'g'ri juftlangan javob qaysi?
physics-killer-09.s.s1.explain: $\Delta m=5.0301-5.0101=0.0200\,\mathrm{u}$ bo'lgani uchun $E=\Delta mc^2=0.0200\times930=18.6\,\mathrm{MeV}$. Reaksiyadan keyingi ikki zarraning impuls kattaligi teng bo'lgani uchun $K=\dfrac{p^2}{2m}\propto\dfrac1m$ va $K_{He}:K_n=1:4$. Demak $K_n=\dfrac45\times18.6=14.88\approx14.9\,\mathrm{MeV}$, $K_{He}\approx3.7\,\mathrm{MeV}$. Massa teskari proporsionalligini teskari yozsa $3.7\,\mathrm{MeV}$ (noto'g'ri javob ②), energiyani yarmiga bo'lsa noto'g'ri javob ③, $\Delta m$ ni $0.0400\,\mathrm{u}$ deb noto'g'ri hisoblasa noto'g'ri javob ④.

physics-killer-09.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.
